project_info.theme: Toyota interior space designed for complete moments together

main_subject.detail: A split-layout lifestyle poster. The left half is a clean white panel with the text 'Khong gian duoc tinh chon de moi khoanh khac ben nhau them tron ven' separated by a thin vertical line, and a dark rounded badge for 'them tron ven'. The right half shows a real interior photo from the back seat of a Toyota, with a male driver on a sunny residential street. The panoramic glass roof is visible above, the Toyota logo sits at top right, and the center screen shows a navigation map and media UI. The driver smiles in the rear-view mirror.
main_subject.style: Minimal premium interior-lifestyle poster with editorial split composition and realistic cabin photography

composition_elements.text: Khong gian duoc tinh chon / de moi khoanh khac ben nhau / them tron ven / TOYOTA
items: Top Left: Large white space with the first half of the slogan
Top Right: Toyota logo over the right-side interior photo
Bottom Left: Dark rounded text pill containing 'them tron ven'
Bottom Right: Real Toyota interior with driver, center display, and steering wheel
Center/Background: Vertical split between a minimalist text panel and an in-cabin lifestyle photograph with panoramic roof

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sunlight through glass roof, calm editorial contrast, soft leather texture visibility

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal interior lifestyle campaign image with minimalist layout design

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota interior lifestyle story about carefully designed space. Centerpiece is a split composition with a white text panel on the left and a real cabin photo on the right showing a male driver, panoramic roof, steering wheel, navigation screen, and sunny street ahead. Background is intentionally minimal with strong white space and editorial balance. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo and the exact Vietnamese line 'Khong gian duoc tinh chon de moi khoanh khac ben nhau them tron ven'. Technical style: photoreal interior lifestyle campaign image with minimalist layout design, natural interior lighting, soft sunlight and visible leather texture, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
